Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Gay Week in Review, with Andy Humm, Darrell Yates Rist, NYU student David Strah, and Jim Levin, sponsored by the Human Rights Campaign Fund 2. Announcement of GCN Pledge Month 3. Discussion of Brooklyn College refusal to give award to anti-gay Catholic Bishop Francis J. Mugavero, the political backlash against Brooklyn College's decision, and how the gay community can confront religious bigotry COMMERCIAL: GCN Fundraiser 4. Condom availability in prisons and in colleges, whether condoms are "catching on" COMMERCIAL: Human Rights Campaign Fund 5. Andy Humm on the necessity of activists and volunteers in the gay community 6. News Watch, anti-gay psychologist Paul Cameron changes the name of his organization to "The Family Research Institute" 7. Oklahoma, Republican Party platform is anti-gay, despite the Republican governor's approval of sex education in schools 8. Hollywood, television shows and films win awards at the Alliance for Gay and Lesbian Artists awards for positive portrayals of gay characters 9. Dallas police arm selves with gloves, masks, and insect repellent due to fear of contracting AIDS 10. Clips from a speech by New York Governor Mario Cuomo, on the passage of an executive order for the protection of gay and lesbian employees COMMERCIAL: Dancing Cheek to Cheek GCN event 11. Lavender Health, interview with Damien Martin, co-founder of the Institute for the Protection of Lesbian and Gay Youth and Professor at New York University, about specific needs in educating gay youths 12. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. Media Watch with Brandon Judell, short stories and clip of Mayor Koch talking about Ronald Reagan's inactivity regarding AIDS funding COMMERCIAL: GCN Fundraiser 2. Naming Names, criticism of Max Frankel of the New York Times 3. Episode 5 of GCN's soap opera, "Suds": "A Brief Crisis" 4. Closing credits
